AccessComparisonResult.description: Machine-readable result of one access-rule comparison.

missing.description: Required values missing from the evaluated operand, when applicable.

operator.description: Policy operator applied to the operands.

AccessOperand.description: Typed operand captured while an access rule is evaluated.

assertions.description: Assertions addressed by an assertion operand.

categoryId.description: Category addressed by an assertion operand.

path.description: Dot-path for subject or context operands.

source.description: Source domain from which the value was read.

AccessOperandSource.description: Source of one operand in an access-policy comparison.

AccessRuleActivation.description: Machine-readable record of why an access rule activated.

matched.description: Whether the rule's activation predicate matched.

ArtifactKind.description: Closed artifact families participating in a composed operation.

ArtifactReference.description: Identifies an immutable artifact participating in a composed operation.

digest.description: Content digest when the resolver can supply one.

AssertionReference.description: Compact reference to an assertion without engine-production metadata.

BestEffortRuleSourceReference.description: Best-effort external source join carried by a qualified rule reference.

providerId.description: Stable identifier for the source provider.

reproducibility.description: Whether the source observation can be reproduced byte-for-byte.

snapshotId.description: Snapshot identity is forbidden when reproducibility is not proven.

ConceptModernization.description:
One deprecated-to-current concept substitution that processing applied before an access rule was evaluated.

The id fields are machine keys; the `*Display` companions carry the rendered marking view, following the same split as `missing` / `missingDisplay`.

conceptId.description: Current concept the access rule was evaluated against.

replacedConceptId.description: Deprecated concept the data was actually marked with.

ReproducibleRuleSourceReference.description: Compact source join carried by a qualified rule reference.

providerId.description: Stable identifier for the source provider.

reproducibility.description: Whether the source observation can be reproduced byte-for-byte.

RuleReference.description: Identifies the exact resolved semantics of one policy rule.

ruleDigest.description: RFC 8785/SHA-256 digest of the canonical resolved rule content.

ruleId.description: Rule identifier within the owning artifact.

source.description: External source identity when the rule was not supplied inline.

RuleSourceReference.description: Compact source join carried by a qualified rule reference.

description: Result of evaluating a single qualified access rule entry.

comparisons.description: Machine-readable comparisons evaluated by the rule.

modernizedFrom.description:
Deprecated-to-current concept substitutions that processing applied to the data before this rule was evaluated.

Present only when the data carried a deprecated concept. It completes the explanation of the decision: the marking the document bears, the current concept it resolved to, and the comparison this rule actually made. A consumer showing why access was granted or denied should surface it, so the verdict is never reported against a concept the reader never saw.

name.description: Rule name from the access policy (for display).

reason.description: Denial reason from the rule definition or generated explanation.

rule.description: Qualified rule identity and semantic digest.

ruleIndex.description: Zero-based index of the rule in the access policy's evaluated rules.

skipped.description: Whether the rule was skipped because its activation did not match.
